title: Wintrail
description: Your private, encrypted trail of work wins: quick log, standup drafts for Teams, year-in-review for appraisals, and break reminders.

title: Packwise — Package Manager for NuGet, npm and PyPI
description: Manage the NuGet packages of your .NET solutions, the npm packages of your Node.js projects and the PyPI packages of your Python projects (uv) in a Visual Studio-like package manager: browse, install, update, consolidate, vulnerable and deprecated packages.

title: PR Ready Check
description: Find leftover debug statements (console.log, debugger, System.out.println, printStackTrace, println!, dbg!) in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java and Rust before you open a pull request. Fix or ignore each one.

title: Yedera Companion
description: AI coding companion for VS Code with project context, code editing, and browser tools.

title: Avron
description: One labelled sponsor line in the status bar while an AI agent thinks; it clears the moment the agent stops. Reads no project files. Needs Avron installed (npx @wbcode/avron install).

title: E-Invoice Validator (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Peppol)
description: Validate XRechnung, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X, Peppol BIS, EN 16931 (UBL, CII), Facturae and KSeF invoices with the official rule sets. Errors show in the Problems panel with rule id and line.
